after-demon-slayer.npc: You're a hero now. That was a good bit of demonslaying.

options.text: How do you know I killed it?

steps.player: How do you know I killed it?

steps.npc: You forget. I'm good at knowing things.
In the scheme of things you are very young.

options.text: Ok but how old are you?

steps.player: Ok, but how old are you?

steps.npc: Count the number of legs on the stools in the Blue Moon inn, and multiply that number by seven.

options.text: Oh if it's in the scheme of things that's ok.

steps.player: Oh if it's in the scheme of things that's ok.

steps.npc: You show wisdom for one so young.

after-recipe-for-disater.player: There's just one thing I don't understand about that whole time travel culinaromancer thing...

after-recipe-for-disater.npc: I wouldn't worry about it too much if I were you. The world is safe once more thanks to your assistance.

after-recipe-for-disater.player: Yeah, I guess... I just wish things made sense is all...

contacting-through-astral-contacts-rando.npc: Because I can tell the future.
That is the answer to your next question.

contacting-through-astral-contacts-rando.player: But how did you know what I would ask?

contacting-through-astral-contacts-rando.npc: Because I can tell the future.
Thanks. Oh and be careful in the Wilderness. Tonight is not your night.

treasure-trails-elite.text: You've [been given a new clue/found a casket]!
